# CircleCI — Startup program

Up to $20,000 in free compute credits and up to 24 months of use, plus free Starter Support (stated as valued at $249 per month) and guided onboarding. Credit amount and promotional period vary by startup stage and location.

|---|---|
| **Status** | Open - apply directly |

| **Last verified** | 2026-09-14 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [🛠️ Developer Tools](../categories/devtools.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | credit |
| **Maximum** | $20,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Duration** | 24 months |
| **Expiry** | The promotional period ends either when the credits are fully consumed or the promotional period ends. |
| **When it ends** | Once you run out of your credits or at the end of the promotional period (whichever comes first), we have several options to meet your needs including premium support and volume discounts. |


### Not covered

- existing paid CircleCI customers

**Stages named by the vendor:** pre-seed, seed, series-a

### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

All four criteria must be met: "New to CircleCI, or on Free plan / Pre-Seed through Series A / Founded within the last 5 years / Part of a recognized accelerator or VC. If none, proof of funding for a minimum of $500K USD raised". The $500K is a FLOOR and applies only to applicants with no accelerator or VC affiliation. CircleCI also states "The amount of free credits and duration of the promotional period vary based upon startup stage and location" but does not publish the location tiers, so the stated maximums may not be available everywhere. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
